text:
Sara (Sales): quick heads-up — UnifiedHealth exec kickoff tomorrow. CISO asked for a 1-page risk summary + current blockers before the meeting. need owners/etas.

Mike (SE): short checklist: BYO-KMS attestation, allowlist/ip peering, SAML prod test, throughput numbers for their ~10k MAU profile.

Carla (CSM): timeline: security questionnaire EOD Fri, DPA redlines Tue, customer expects live POC in ~3 weeks.

Nina (Security): I can take the questionnaire. Q: they say "complete traceability for PHI flows" — do they want host logs or only audit events?

Mike (SE): both ideally. for POC we can provide console audit logs; streaming to SIEM requires infra hookup.

Ash (Eng): we can emit to S3 or Kinesis. ~3 dev-days to implement and test streaming for the POC.

Oliver (Legal): on DPA: residency is fine for eu-west-1 for pilot, subprocessors clause needs gated approval. will draft narrow redline.

Sara (Sales): can someone assemble a risk matrix with Residual risk, Owner, ETA — I'll add commercial notes and send to customer.

Mike (SE): draft status:
- BYO KMS: blocker (waiting attestation) — owner: Oliver/Nina — ETA: Tue
- IP allowlist/peering: partial (ranges received) — owner: Ash — ETA: 48h
- SAML SSO: staging ready — owner: Carla/Mike — ETA: 2d
- Throughput perf: needs runtime report — owner: Ash — ETA: 4d

Nina (Security): KMS attestation template (send to customer): "We confirm our customer-managed KMS (vendor X) is HSM-backed, AES-256, rotates keys every 90 days, and logs retained 365d, exportable on request."

Carla (CSM): I'll send that to their security contact now.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: `staging/enable-saml-test` (2025-06-11T09:12:03Z).

Ash (Eng): perf note: redwood-gpt-3.4-q4 ~120 tokens/s per GPU at seq_len=512. for their profile (~120 tokens/session, 10k MAU) monthly tokens ~1.2B — recommend reserved capacity. I'll post calc later.

Oliver (Legal): pushing back on unlimited liability in subprocessors. will upload redline shortly.

Mike (SE): action items: 1) Mike produce 1-slide risk matrix (ETA: EOD today). 2) Nina prep questionnaire answers + KMS template (ETA: tomorrow). 3) Ash run perf calc + test peering (ETA: 48h). 4) Oliver start DPA redlines (ETA: Tue). 5) Carla collect attestation + confirm IPs (ETA: today).

Carla (CSM): pinging customer: @unifiedhealth-sec for attestation and IP confirmation.

Sara (Sales): great. please react with :eyes: when you've reviewed Oliver's DPA redline so I can send.

Carla (CSM): :eyes:

Mike (SE): :eyes:

Nina (Security): :eyes:

Ash (Eng): :eyes:

Oliver (Legal): uploaded DPA redline: https://redwood.app/drive/unifiedhealth/dpa-redline-v1 — will iterate.

Sara (Sales): thanks — I'll compile the 1-pager and post before EOD. if any critical blocker shows up, @here notify me immediately. :thumbsup:
